definitions.face: Within 10 degrees of the direction from current position to fixed target, sustained 0.10s.
definitions.ontoLine: At least 90% of starting/requested speed and velocity within 10 degrees of current target direction, sustained 0.10s.
definitions.lateral: Maximum perpendicular distance from the direct start-to-target line over the approach.
definitions.braking: Path travelled to first plant. Null means no deliberate braking phase.
definitions.ratio: Travelled path divided by direct start-to-observed-endpoint distance.
